data.name: Cult Totem, Lesser
data.description: While the barbarian is raging, any morale bonuses or bonuses for flanking she gains on attacks rolls are added to her damage rolls instead of her attack rolls. They are still morale bonuses, and they don't stack with other morale bonuses on damage rolls.
